**Notice: Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**

To better protect your account and personal information, we strongly encourage you to turn on two-factor authentication.

**Why it matters:** A password alone may not be enough to keep your account secure. 2FA adds a second verification step, such as a code sent to your phone or generated by an authenticator app, so that even if someone obtains your password, they cannot access your account.

**How to enable it:**
1. Sign in and go to **Settings** > **Security**.
2. Select **Two-Factor Authentication**.
3. Choose your preferred method: authenticator app (recommended), text message, or security key.
4. Follow the on-screen prompts to confirm your setup.
5. Save your backup codes in a safe place in case you lose access to your device.

**Please note:** Setup takes only a few minutes. We recommend completing it by the end of the week.

If you need help, contact our support team. We will never ask you to share your verification codes with anyone.

Thank you for helping keep your account secure.
